content: Obesity is a risk factor for the development of several cancers, such as breast, colon, and gynecologic carcinomas<sup>1,2</sup>. Recent findings have clarified that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also influences the prognosis of patients with several types of cancer. For example, obesity has been correlated with poor prognosis in breast<sup>3,4</sup> and colon cancers<sup>5,6</sup>, while favorable prognoses have been reported in obese patients with gastric<sup>7</sup> or renal<sup>8</sup> cancers.
